review_locator: PMCID:PMC6811606, Transcriptional, Epigenetic and Pharmacological Control of JAK/STAT Pathway in NK Cells; PMCID:PMC8726596, Transcriptional and epigenetic regulation of memory NK cell responses
primary_title: Transcription factor IRF8 orchestrates the adaptive natural killer cell response
decision_basis: The reviews identify IL-12/STAT4 as an upstream regulator of IRF8 in NK cells; the cited primary shows IL-12-receptor/STAT4-dependent Irf8 induction during MCMV responses and loss of maximal induction when NK cells cannot respond to IL-12/STAT4.
limitations_preserved: IL-12/STAT4 dependence supports a bounded NK-cell Irf8 gene-regulation edge, but the primary does not establish universal STAT4-only promoter occupancy or IRF8 protein abundance outside this infection/cytokine context; no direct IL-12 protein secretion, SCI relevance, or terminal-TF inference is made.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6811606, Transcriptional, Epigenetic and Pharmacological Control of JAK/STAT Pathway in NK Cells; PMCID:PMC8726596, Transcriptional and epigenetic regulation of memory NK cell responses
primary_title: Transcription factor IRF8 orchestrates the adaptive natural killer cell response
decision_basis: The reviews identify ZBTB32 as an IRF8-regulated NK-cell gene; the cited primary shows IRF8 enrichment at the Zbtb32 promoter and links IRF8 loss to reduced Zbtb32 expression and impaired virus-specific NK-cell expansion.
limitations_preserved: Direct IRF8 promoter enrichment plus expression/function comparisons support a bounded NK-cell IRF8-to-ZBTB32 gene bridge; partner dependence and infection-state context remain unresolved, and no universal protein, secretion, SCI, or terminal-TF inference is made.
